_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Three distinct Peruvian Fiscalía drug-trafficking case networks; 24 named people convicted as of 2023/2024 official report dates. Report dates do not assert exact judgment days. Group sentence ranges are not assigned as individual terms. Peru country markers refer to source-backed historical case/organization activity, not nationality, arrest-only location, or current positions. No direct person-to-person ties, exact operational routes, private addresses, or unlicensed photographs.

source.claim: Fiscalía individually lists Emerson Cuadros Laura as a Transportadores del Norte member and reports that appellate judges confirmed convictions for the eleven named members in a Peruvian drug-trafficking case. The release gives only a group sentence range of 12–15 years.
